token = apis.gmail.login(username='saritt@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='gmail'][0])['access_token']

page_limit = 20
all_ids = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    threads = apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=token, read=True, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(threads))
    if not threads:
        break
    all_ids.extend([t['email_thread_id'] for t in threads])
    page_index += 1

# dedupe just in case
unique_ids = sorted(set(all_ids))
print('total_unique_read_inbox_threads', len(unique_ids))
print('sample_ids', unique_ids[:10])
